🇨🇳 A-Share Stock DashboardA股个股看板 ?A stock-picking watchlist for China A-shares: names that sold off hard and just started turning back up. Rank means how ready a setup looks to buy — research context, not advice.A股选股观察表：大幅回调后刚开始回升的个股。排序表示形态离买点有多近——研究参考，非投资建议。

Regime周期: Stagflation滞胀?The macro / economic regime (growth × inflation quadrant) the whole page is filtered by — it describes the ECONOMY, not today's tape, so it shifts slowly. Use it for which sectors & factors are favoured, not for market timing. For whether the market itself is turning over, use the China macro dashboard's risk read.整页据以过滤的宏观／经济周期（增长×通胀象限）— 它描述的是经济，而非今日盘面，因此变化缓慢。用于判断哪些板块与因子占优，而非择时。市场本身是否转向，请看中国宏观看板的风险读数。 Posture姿态: DEFENSIVE防御?How to TRADE the current regime — a defensive → aggressive stance dial (Defensive · Careful · Neutral · Constructive · Aggressive) set by the playbook. It sizes risk; it is not a buy/sell or stock-selection call. The full dial with its reasoning lives on the China macro dashboard.如何“交易”当前周期 — 一个防御→进取的姿态刻度（防御·谨慎·中性·建设性·进取），由策略手册设定。它用于调整风险敞口，并非买卖或选股建议。完整刻度及其推理见中国宏观看板。

Risk backdrop风险背景 ELEVATED — trade smaller偏高 — 减小仓位 · main risk: Breadth breakdown主要风险：广度普跌 · as of截至 2026-07-22 ?CN drawdown radar: external-driver risk (US rate shocks, USD/CNH, US–China yield gap, market breadth). Sets a risk backdrop for sizing — context only, never vetoes names or changes board rank (CN-SYS-R7).CN回撤雷达：衡量外部驱动风险（美债利率冲击、美元/人民币、中美利差、市场广度）。用于设定仓位风险背景——仅供背景参考，不排除个股或改变看板排名（CN-SYS-R7）。

⚡ What to Act On Now现在行动 v2 ?Four lanes, read left to right: Buy Now = a clean entry point today. In Favour = still in favour, but it has run — wait for a dip. Bottoming Watch = beaten-down groups showing the first signs of turning up (watch only, never a buy signal). Reduce / Avoid = the trend is weakening. Rows mix investment themes (scored 0-100 by the basket engine) and sectors (timed by the cycle ladder). A name can honestly sit in two lanes at once — e.g. weakening trend but an early bottom forming — and is shown in both, never merged.四个分栏从左到右：立即买入＝今天有干净入场点。看好＝仍看好但已涨高，等回调再买。洗盘观察＝超跌板块初现回升迹象（仅观察，绝非买入信号）。减仓/回避＝趋势转弱。行内混合投资主题（篮子引擎0-100打分）与行业板块（周期阶梯定时机）。同一名称可能同时出现在两个分栏——例如趋势转弱但初现筑底——两种判读并列显示，永不合并。

Each card is an A-share name that sold off hard, settled, and just turned back up (the system grades that washout → base → fresh-turn sequence, T1–T4). Score 0–100 = buy-readiness: how ready it looks to buy, not a win-rate or a guarantee. Rank puts the cleanest setups first. Two gauges show setup quality and entry timing (buy now vs wait for a pullback). It is a research shortlist, not a buy list — and its track record is still accruing.如何看这个榜单。每张卡片都是一只大幅回调、企稳后刚刚回升的A股（系统按 洗盘→筑底→新转向 顺序分级，T1–T4）。评分0–100＝买入就绪度：该股离买点有多近，并非胜率或保证。排序把形态最干净的排在前面。两个量表显示形态质量与入场时机（现在买还是等回调）。这是研究备选清单，而非买入清单——其成绩仍在累积。
